label: A field mark
caption: Explaining a field mark
text: See that tail? Sticks up like a teapot handle.

label: A first lifer
caption: First wren recorded
text: Your first wren. There. I’ll put the date under that one.

label: Meet Dot
caption: Meeting Dot
text: Dot Lau. I drew shop signs for years. Birds do fidget more.

label: A bird slips away
caption: A missed sighting
text: Well. Got the back half of him. That’s the useful half of a wren.

label: A quiet word
caption: A little reassurance
text: I’ve got a whole book of ones that got away. Sit with me a bit.

label: In the sketchbook
caption: Making a field note
text: Round body. Tail up. Feet can wait.
